name: @cfmeeting/desktop
description: CFMeeting desktop shell for Windows and macOS (Electron)
author: CFMeeting contributors

scripts.start: npm run build:main && npm run prepare:renderer && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build:main && npm run prepare:renderer && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:main && npm run prepare:renderer && electron-builder --publish never --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:main && npm run prepare:renderer && electron-builder --publish never --win
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:main && npm run prepare:renderer && electron-builder --publish never --dir
